/careers.title: Careers - Join Our Team
/careers.description: Join EudTech and be part of the future of AI technology. Explore our openings, responsibilities, requirements and application process.
highlights: Review each opening for responsibilities, requirements, location and working hours.
Use the application instructions in the job listing to apply for a suitable role.

/.title: AI Agents, GPU Infrastructure & Social Intelligence
/.description: EudTech helps enterprises, research teams and public institutions in Taiwan implement AI agents, Comino GPU systems and Cyabra social intelligence.
highlights: Connect AI agents and headless SaaS to existing business systems, with defined permissions and reviewable actions.
Plan liquid-cooled GPU infrastructure around workloads, power, space, heat removal and acceptance criteria.
Use Cyabra social intelligence to examine profiles, coordinated activity, narratives and brand risk.

/solutions.title: AI & Digital Solutions
/solutions.description: Choose an EudTech delivery path for enterprise AI agents and headless SaaS, GPU infrastructure or Cyabra social intelligence.
highlights: AI agents and headless SaaS: connect existing ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, databases and authorised APIs.
AI infrastructure: turn workload and site requirements into a configuration, quote and deployment plan.
Social intelligence: define an issue, evidence requirements and the decisions the analysis must support.

/solutions/ai-agent.title: Enterprise AI Agents & Headless SaaS
/solutions/ai-agent.description: Connect ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, databases and APIs through branded interfaces, event workflows and controlled AI agents with human review and audit records.
highlights: Start with one concrete workflow and identify its data, systems, permissions, owners and acceptance criteria.
Retain effective existing systems and build the customer or staff interface the workflow needs.
Use authorised APIs and events, scoped tools, approval steps and traceable execution records.
Validate a pilot before expanding automation or developing a multi-tenant service.

/solutions/ai-infrastructure.title: Comino Liquid-Cooled GPU Servers & AI Workstations
/solutions/ai-infrastructure.description: Plan Comino GRANDO GPU servers and workstations in Taiwan with workload sizing, power and cooling review, manufacturer documents and procurement evidence.
highlights: Choose deskside or rack deployment from noise, available space, power, heat removal and sustained workload requirements.
The closed internal cooling loop transfers heat to the radiator; room ventilation and air conditioning still require review.
Review the selected GPU and CPU platform, memory, storage, software and inter-GPU communication as one system.
Confirm monitoring, quick disconnect procedures, warranty and power redundancy against the selected model and load.
Use the GRANDO Server v2.3 datasheet and RM v2.0.2 guide as technical references; conformity and test evidence must match the delivered configuration.

/solutions/social-intelligence.title: Cyabra Social Intelligence & Brand Protection
/solutions/social-intelligence.description: EudTech uses Cyabra to help communications, security and public-sector teams analyse inauthentic profiles, coordinated activity, narratives and brand risk.
highlights: Define the issue, relevant public sources, timeframe and decision owner.
Examine profiles, coordinated behaviour and narrative spread with reviewable evidence.
Agree the analysis output, licensing direction and pilot scope before implementation.

/products.title: Products & Brands
/products.description: Explore EudTech software and implementation services, Comino liquid-cooled GPU workstations and servers, and Cyabra social intelligence.
highlights: EudTech software and enterprise AI implementation connect data and workflows.
Comino GRANDO systems support workload-led workstation and server planning.
Cyabra supports evidence-led analysis of public social activity and narratives.

/resources.title: GPU Server Selection & Procurement Resources
/resources.description: Compare GPU server and workstation requirements, plan power and cooling, prepare an RFQ and review procurement documents with EudTech.
highlights: Start from models, precision, concurrency, throughput and the required GPU memory.
Check rack space, input power, room heat removal, noise and maintenance access.
Keep a configuration link and prepare an RFQ with delivery, warranty and acceptance requirements.
Review manufacturer documents and the scope of evidence for the selected equipment.

/about.title: About EudTech | Eudaemonia Technology
/about.description: Eudaemonia Technology helps enterprises, researchers and public institutions connect AI software, compute systems and intelligence tools to practical workflows.
highlights: Requirements, sources, approvals, acceptance criteria and ownership are written down.
EudTech combines software integration, workload-led hardware planning and evidence-led intelligence.
Bring one concrete problem to identify the information and scope needed for the next step.

/contact.title: Contact EudTech
/contact.description: Discuss an AI workflow, GPU configuration or social intelligence need with EudTech. Start with the workload, existing systems and intended outcome.
highlights: Send your question to info@eudaemonia.tech or use the consultation form.
For GPU systems, include software, workload, deployment location and available power and cooling.
For AI workflows, identify the existing systems, data sources and desired output.
EudTech will propose the next step: discovery, a pilot, configuration review, a demonstration or a formal quote.

/privacy.title: Privacy & Data Use
/privacy.description: Learn how EudTech handles contact and quote data, customer-source attribution, retention, service providers and data requests.
highlights: Contact, company and configuration information is used to understand requests, prepare replies and maintain related business records.
Attribution may include campaign parameters, referrers and anonymous identifiers. Personal email addresses are not placed in public URLs.
Browser attribution data may be retained for up to 90 days. Customer-provided source information is kept separately.
Hosting, analytics, Microsoft 365, email and customer-record services support website operation and replies. Information is not sold.
Quote and business records are retained for service, contract, audit and legal needs, then deleted or de-identified when the purpose ends.
For access, correction, restriction or deletion requests, contact info@eudaemonia.tech. The notice is effective from 16 August 2026.

/configurator.title: Comino GRANDO GPU Server Configurator
/configurator.description: Configure Comino GRANDO GPU servers and AI workstations, review GPU, CPU, memory, storage, power and networking, and request a formal quote in Taiwan.
highlights: Compare available Comino platforms and select the components needed for your workload.
Keep a shareable configuration link for technical and procurement review.
Submit the selected configuration and contact information for EudTech to confirm specifications, availability and a formal quotation.
